invariants.statement: A COMPLETE work item has a completion receipt.
An executable item has no unresolved blocking dependency.
UNKNOWN and CONTRADICTED obligations are not emitted as executable TODOs.

diagnostics.mechanism: compare completion state to required evidence receipts
candidate interpretation only after deterministic graph and receipt checks are exhausted

verification_oracles.condition: ready set and dependency closure reproduce deterministically
every COMPLETE item resolves to the required receipt

ruin_boundaries.guard: Do not widen scope or mutate unrelated work items during packet execution.

MISSING_DEPENDENCY.action: BLOCK and identify the missing dependency ID.

CYCLE.action: BLOCK the affected component and preserve independent ready work.

UNRESOLVED.action: Create a typed unresolved object, preserve rival plans and seek a discriminating witness.

order: find the smallest acceptance or dependency distinction
compile the learned distinction into a graph rule or recipe

donors.mechanism: dependency graph triage, ready work, critical path and cycle analysis
donors.claim_boundary: Graph analysis informs planning state; it does not establish implementation completion or authority.

donors.mechanism: local dependency task graph with explicit state
donors.claim_boundary: Task records and readiness are coordination state, not proof of external effects.

donors.mechanism: RESIDUALIZE obligation partition and evidence-gated work receipts
donors.claim_boundary: Only admitted evidence changes obligation or work verdicts.
